version_enum: N/A — AnimateDiff gets NO VERSION_ enum. It is a motion-module add-on loaded alongside an existing SD1.x UNet (VERSION_SD1 / VERSION_SD1_INPAINT / VERSION_SD1_PIX2PIX), gated by a boolean flag, not a distinct model version.
vae: SD 1.x VAE — the base model's existing first_stage_model (AutoencoderKL). AnimateDiff adds NO VAE. Frames are decoded one-at-a-time through the standard SD VAE (see upstream stable-diffusion.cpp ~line 5051-5064, the per-frame decode_first_stage loop keyed on animatediff_num_frames). No change to the fork VAE factory.
conditioner: SD 1.x conditioner — the base model's existing FrozenCLIPEmbedder (CLIP ViT-L/14, context_dim 768). AnimateDiff adds NO text encoder/conditioner and needs no fork-convention construction; it rides the unchanged SD1 conditioner path.
notes:
KEY FINDING: The task premise (convert a *Runner from upstream's ModelManager convention to the fork's params_backend convention) DOES NOT APPLY to animatediff. src/model/diffusion/animatediff.hpp is byte-identical to upstream/master, contains NO *Runner class, NO conditioner/embedder class, and NO model_manager/ModelManager references. It is a pure GGMLBlock motion-module library (TemporalAttention/TemporalTransformer/MotionModule/AnimateDiffModel) that uses only fork-available primitives — GGMLRunnerContext (ctx->ggml_ctx, ctx->backend), ggml_ext_attention_ext (8-arg form matches fork src/core/ggml_extend.hpp:1574), FeedForward::Activation::GEGLU, GroupNorm/LayerNorm/Linear/Embedding (all present in fork block.hpp). I therefore made ZERO edits to animatediff.hpp (hpp_adapted=false); it already compiles against the fork.

CONSEQUENCE FOR THE INTEGRATOR: Do NOT add a VERSION_ANIMATEDIFF enum, do NOT add a get_sd_version() detection branch in model_loader.cpp, and do NOT add an else-if to the diffusion-model dispatch factory. Those would be wrong for this model. The real integration is entirely: (a) additive detection + block instantiation + forward motion-lambda wiring inside src/model/diffusion/unet.hpp (the fork's UNetModelRunner is ALREADY in fork convention — backend/params_backend ctor, num_video_frames already threaded — so upstream's additive snippets paste cleanly), and (b) glue in src/stable-diffusion.cpp (load flag, motion_module_path load, num_video_frames->UNetDiffusionExtra, generate_animatediff_video + dispatch, per-frame VAE decode). None of it needs backend_for/params_backend_for because no new runner is constructed.
